notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 1.0.7.0
notes.notes:
[h1]ADVERSE - Build 1.0.7.0[/h1]

[b]Build 1.0.7.0 is due to be pushed live on 14th April 2021.[/b]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Address an issue with level score based achievements not unlocking correctly.
    [*]Slightly modified Utopia #3 and #5 geometry.
[/list]

[h1]Further information[/h1]
If you find any bugs, glitches or just want to suggest feedback, feel free create a new discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1295390/discussions/]here[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 1.0.6.1
notes.notes:
[h1]ADVERSE - Build 1.0.6.1[/h1]

[b]Build 1.0.6.1 is due to be pushed live on 14th March 2021.[/b]

[b]Online:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Removed Adept Platformer achievements on Steam - due to issues with method of unlocking.
    [*]Updated method of incrementing statistics.
    [*]Various optimisations in Steam calls.
    [*]Enemies destroyed achievements are now more reliable.
[/list]

[h1]Further information[/h1]
If you find any bugs, glitches or just want to suggest feedback, feel free create a new discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1295390/discussions/]here[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 1.0.6.0
notes.notes:
[h1]ADVERSE - Build 1.0.6.0[/h1]

[b]Build 1.0.6.0 is due to be pushed live on 14th February 2021.[/b]

[i]Scores acquired by using the superspeed glitch have been removed in the interest of fairness.[/i]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Addressed Geometry misplacement within various levels.
    [*]In-Game HUD is now more accurate with Jump element updates.
    [*]Overhaul to Dash mechanic (Still functions in the same way, however is now more reliable).
[/list]

[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Addressed superspeed glitch.
[/list]

[h1]Further information[/h1]
If you find any bugs, glitches or just want to suggest feedback, feel free create a new discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1295390/discussions/]here[/url]
